exposure: gestational age at delivery (37-38 weeks vs 38-39 weeks)
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission for respiratory morbidity
cohort: Women who underwent scheduled early term cesarean delivery of a singleton, non-anomalous neonate
finding: Betamethasone course administered prior to planned early term cesarean delivery was associated with a statistically significant reduction in the neonatal composite respiratory morbidity compared with routine management.
